## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Cyclicals showing breadth-led strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%)) while risk indicators are mixed (VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +4.48%) rising; SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%) and TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +0.07%) flat), producing a neutral overall signal.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Commodity/cyclical strength: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%) confirming cyclical leadership; Credit neutral: HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.56%) and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +0.32%) → HYG/LQD NEUTRAL; Fear mixed: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +4.48%) rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%) vs TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +0.07%) shows no decisive stock-vs-bond tilt, and HYG/LQD remains NEUTRAL (both in CORRECTION).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading: Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%), Materials MOO ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +10.65%), Industrials breadth strong; Tech weak: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%) — Style: Cyclicals over Growth.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%); EM/China uneven with EEM CORRECTION (1W: -1.23% | 1M: +5.97%) and FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -2.76%) — global participation present but China lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Cooling: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.48% | 1M: -15.00%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -6.22%) show speculative drawdown while small caps IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.74% | 1M: +5.63%) remain range-bound.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity/industrial strength: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%), XME showing 1M gains (XME CORRECTION (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +15.86%)) while precious metals show short-term profit taking — GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +14.06%) and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -24.24% | 1M: +17.05%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strong: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%), BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +12.34%); natural gas volatile: UNG CORRECTION (1W: -11.70% | 1M: +7.63%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy/commodities (XLE, BNO, CPER) are ABOVE TREND across 1W and 1M. DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches in commodities and miners (URA, SLV, GLD) and broad tech weakness (XLK, QQQ, IGV, SOXX) create short-term noise — treat as transitional.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to cyclicals and commodity-linked ETFs showing momentum (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%)); reduce exposure to technology/thematic risk (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%), ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -6.22%)); bonds neutral (TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +0.07%)).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%); Materials — MOO ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +10.65%). BEARISH: Technology — XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%); Thematics/Crypto — ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -6.22%), IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.48% | 1M: -15.00%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent/Oil — BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%), Copper — CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%). BEARISH: Silver/precious metals near-term pullback — SLV CORRECTION (1W: -24.24% | 1M: +17.05%), Gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +14.06%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20–25 (fear pivot) — VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +4.48%); HYG/LQD spread (watch credit pulse) — HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.56%), LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +0.32%); XLK/XLV or XLK/XLF spreads for growth vs value pivot (monitor XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%) and XLF RECOVERY (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -2.55%)).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, producing mixed but broadly cyclically-biased internals. Energy and materials showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%), MOO ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +10.65%)); key risk is persistent tech/thematic weakness and short-term volatility (XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%), VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +4.48%)) to monitor.
